highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves Ganesh failure handling and fixes a native shader-code generation use-after-free.

bullets.lead: Failed GPU work no longer leaves stale readbacks
bullets.detail: Propagates failed flushes, restores resolve-task dirty tracking, and includes the Imagination GPU framebuffer-deletion workaround.
Includes the upstream shader-code generation use-after-free correction and additional same-milestone fixes.
